$schema-note: Run id prefix -> what this site is allowed to call that run. The harvest fails closed: a run in the store with no entry here is excluded from src/data/corpus.json entirely, so it can never be published under its real name. Nothing private belongs in this file either - no repo paths, no plan names, no client anything. `label` is the key content cites in `evidence.runs`; `scenario` is the sentence a reader maps their own situation onto; `repoKey` is the generalised identity of the repo, and distinct repoKeys are what the site counts as repos. `disposition` is required when the store still marks a run `running`, because the store cannot tell an abandoned run from a paused one - a July run whose engine exited without closing the record looks exactly like a run somebody means to come back to.
